association_design.analysis_unit: endpoint mean over three reconstructed splits
association_design.multiplicity: Holm correction within each four-association family
association_design.outcome_definition: full MAE minus parameter-efficient-method MAE; positive favors the parameter-efficient method

size_adjustment.model: endpoint mean log1p(unique BM scaffolds) ~ intercept + endpoint mean log1p(train rows)

interpretation_boundary: Post hoc associations across 23 endpoints do not establish a causal method-selection rule; endpoint family, label noise, size, and diversity remain confounded, and only frozen mixing, LoRA, and full fine-tuning were tested.
